channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel B
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel B (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel B: Pier 70 Parcel B now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 70 Parcel B now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4052008 and 4052012.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel B: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel B: Parcel B now says it is in proposed Phase 3B without tying it to the pump station site (the Port's exhibit says the pump station is included in the earlier of 3A or 3B). The 2042 completion milestone is now labelled a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset, not a current forecast. The Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022 rather than April 2022, since the sources say only 'last year' and 'earlier this year'. The Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report rather than as a hearing that took place, and the map notes no longer assert an unsupported 500,000 sq ft figure or that the site has not been subdivided by the Assessor. The Figure 1.1.2 image credit no longer says 'adopted 2017', and the Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel B: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) describes proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 7, 2026)
